description: If you've been searching for a proven, capable truck that refuses to quit, this 2003 Toyota Tacoma Xtracab for sale at California Auto Expert in Ontario, California is a vehicle worth serious attention. Toyota Tacomas from this generation are legendary for their ability to accumulate high mileage while remaining mechanically sound when properly maintained. The Xtracab configuration offers the practicality of rear jump seats and extra cabin storage while keeping the full 6-foot bed, making it a genuinely useful truck for daily driving, hauling, or weekend adventures across the Inland Empire. The silver exterior gives it a clean, timeless look that holds up well on working trucks.For the right buyer  someone mechanically savvy, budget-conscious, or simply a believer in Toyota's reputation for longevity  this Tacoma represents outstanding value. High-mileage Tacomas regularly sell for strong prices precisely because the market understands how well these trucks age.2003 Toyota Tacoma Performance and EngineUnder the hood sits Toyota's 2.4-liter four-cylinder engine paired with an automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive. This powertrain combination was a workhorse staple of the early 2000s Tacoma lineup. The 2.4-liter inline-four is known for its simplicity, ease of maintenance, and long service life  many examples of this exact engine have surpassed 400,000 miles with proper care.Rear-wheel drive keeps the drivetrain uncomplicated and cost-effective to maintain. While it won't conquer serious off-road terrain the way a 4x4 would, it's perfectly suited for city driving, highway commutes across San Bernardino County, and light-duty hauling. The automatic transmission makes it accessible and comfortable for everyday use.Toyota Tacoma Features and InteriorThe Xtracab body style gives this Tacoma a meaningful edge over a standard regular cab. The extended rear section provides fold-down jump seats  practical for the occasional passenger  along with extra behind-the-seat storage for tools, bags, or gear. The 6-foot bed is a full, usable hauling platform, well-suited for contractors, landscapers, or anyone who needs real truck utility.This generation of Tacoma kept the interior functional and straightforward. Controls are intuitive, visibility is excellent, and the driving position is upright and commanding. For buyers who want a truck that works rather than a truck that shows off, the simplicity of this interior is a feature, not a limitation.Toyota Tacoma Reliability and OwnershipThe first-generation Toyota Tacoma  particularly those built between 1995 and 2004  has earned near-mythical status among truck enthusiasts and reliability researchers alike. Reach out to the dealership directly at 909-517-2967 to discuss financing terms and get pre-qualified before you come in.Frequently Asked QuestionsIs a high-mileage 2003 Toyota Tacoma a good buy?For the right buyer, absolutely. Mileage alone is not a dealbreaker on a Tacoma. Maintenance history and overall condition matter far more.What does the Xtracab trim mean on a 2003 Tacoma?Xtracab refers to Toyota's extended cab configuration. It features a larger cab than a standard regular cab, with fold-down rear jump seats and additional behind-the-seat storage space. It's a practical middle ground between a regular cab and a full crew cab, offering some passenger flexibility while maintaining a full-length bed.Is rear-wheel drive okay for a truck in Southern California?For most driving in Southern California, rear-wheel drive is perfectly suitable. The Inland Empire sees minimal snow and ice, meaning the main traction scenarios  highway driving, surface streets, light hauling  are well within what a rear-wheel drive Tacoma handles comfortably. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.
